data.long_meaning: Sharwanikaal is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Sharwa meaning 'God of Wisdom' and Kal meaning 'Time' or 'Power'. Thus, Sharwanikaal represents the God who embodies both wisdom and power. The name Sharwanikaal carries the meaning “God of Wisdom and Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharwanikaal usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wisdom and power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharwanikaal is a name for those who seek divine guidance and strength in their lives. It is a name for the wise and powerful, who use their wisdom and strength to make a positive impact in the world.
